errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly simplifies the trend of the growth rate between 2018 and 2021 as a monotonic increase. The chart shows that the rate decreased from 10% in 2018 to 9% in 2019, before increasing in the following years. The description omits the 9% data point and the dip in the trend.

errors.text_span: Общият вид на графиката показва стабилен растеж на пазара и променлив темп на ръст.
errors.evidence: This sentence provides an interpretation and summary of the data trends ('стабилен растеж' - stable growth, 'променлив темп на ръст' - variable growth rate) rather than sticking to a factual description of the chart's elements and values.
